name: Chikura Anri
source: Shou's classmate. Raised by a single mother, they didn't have much money growing up. When he was about to give up going to college, he received an offer from Yuusei Academy to enroll as a scholarschip student. Quiet, small and often gets bullied. He plays the flute in the brass band club.
translation: Shou's classmate. Raised by a single mother, they didn't have much money growing up. When he was about to give up going to college, he received an offer from Yuusei Academy to enroll as a scholarschip student. Quiet, small and often gets bullied. He plays the flute in the brass band club.
